item.title: XRPL Bridge Exploit Drains Nearly 200,000 XRP
item.summary: A software vulnerability in a blockchain bridge connecting the XRP Ledger to the tx blockchain allowed an attacker to create fraudulent deposits and withdraw nearly 200,000 XRP, worth about $200,000, from the bridge’s reserve wallet. The incident exposed a weakness in the bridge’s deposit verification process, which incorrectly treated nonexistent transactions as legitimate deposits.
